answer: Can one cable pretend to be 500 agents? Make it try. Each epoch, three beacon-chosen verifiers each pull a 50 MB blob sealed to a seat's address, and every seat's pulls land in the same 60-second window. A verifier's quartz clock logs the delta between first and last byte; a seat that can't move 150 MB in that minute (~20 Mbps, assumed) goes unpaid. Honest hosts barely notice, but 500 clones on one 1 Gbps line would need ~10 Gbps at once (assumed figures), and no whisper of faked throughput survives a sealed blob.
